S1 — BLOCKING: the selected-effect qualification class remains open in independent and duplicate typed projections.
Invariant/authority: the USER's magic-item-faithful-or-absent decision, owning bead .19.4.5 DESIGN/AC1/AC3, printed item descriptions/tables and ADR 0020 source fidelity require every typed mechanics.effects claim to preserve its printed applicability, trigger, mode and scope exactly, or be absent with an adjudicated verbatim source span. A correct sibling or a resolved table reference does not qualify an independently broader/narrower effect. Profile rules-clause-complete; owner eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5. This is a source-projection defect, not a request for new item execution or whole-item completeness.

Confirmed membership and distinguishing states:
1. Cube of Force / m5-complex-cube-contact. Producer packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:257; records.json:95494. Typed trigger is "a listed spell contacts the barrier". Printed p. 215 says the barrier loses charges when targeted by certain spells OR contacted by certain spell or MAGIC ITEM effects; table:cube-of-force-charges-lost explicitly lists Horn of blasting, 1d10 charges. Scenario: a Horn of Blasting blast contacts the barrier. The printed item-effect branch loses 1d10 charges, but it is excluded by the typed spell-only trigger. Table resolution does not turn the horn into a spell. Keep both source event forms and both source categories; do not merely rename the table or operation.
2. Rod of Lordly Might / m3-rod-of-lordly-might-sense-magnetic-north-and-depth. Producer magicItemPassiveEffects.ts:1285-1289; records.json:126154-126158. Printed p. 240: "If you press button 6, the rod assumes or remains in its normal form and indicates magnetic north." The typed sense is independent and its only condition is that the magnetic-north function does nothing where no magnetic north exists. There is no button-6 predicate, operation effect binding, or state effect binding for this sensor. Scenario: rod remains in its climbing-pole/battleaxe form without pressing button 6, in a location with magnetic north; the positive sense claim grants north indication while the printed selected button function has not been invoked. Preserve the button-specific predicate on the north branch; do not invent an additional gate on the separate depth/height sentence if its scope remains for the DM to interpret.
3. Feather Token / token-kind-payload.variants.whip. Producer magicItemConsumables.ts:306-312; records.json:100712-100724. This is an effect-level part of prior .7 S2.10, not the follow-up's activation-only scope. It still carries an unqualified attackBonus 9, damage 1d6+5 force and moveFeet 20. Printed pp. 221-222 qualifies that selected attack as a MELEE SPELL attack against a CREATURE WITHIN TEN FEET OF THE WHIP, using a bonus action; repeated movement/attack is a bonus action ON YOUR TURN. The separate c2-residual-whip-attack now states those predicates, but this duplicate profile neither carries them nor references that corrected profile; table:feather-token contains only token-kind selection. Scenario: the nested profile does not exclude an attack on an object or a creature beyond ten feet, or a repeated twenty-foot movement/attack outside your turn. Its positive selected attack/movement claims remain broader than the printed attack. This finding concerns the nested attack/movement profile; toss/contact/manifestation operation delivery remains with .19.4.6.
4. Candle of Invocation / c2-residual-invocation-zone. Producer magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:184; records.json:92885. Printed p. 213 grants advantage to matching-alignment creatures "within that light". Typed condition substitutes simply within thirty feet of a burning candle. Scenario: the burning candle is inside an opaque closed enclosure and a matching creature is outside it but within thirty feet; the source's light-membership prerequisite fails while the distance-only condition passes. Preserve membership in the candle's light, including its thirty-foot radius, rather than replacing illumination with proximity. This is the same lost illuminated-area membership form already repaired for Rod of Alertness.
5. Lantern of Revealing / m3-lantern-of-revealing-bright-light and m3-lantern-of-revealing-dim-light. Producer magicItemPassiveEffects.ts:1080-1090; records.json:108335-108347. Printed p. 228 gives the normal 30-foot bright/additional-30-foot dim profile WHILE LIT, and lowering the hood REDUCES it to dim light in a five-foot radius. The independent bright effect is conditioned only on being lit, so it remains applicable with the hood lowered; the dim effect is conditioned only on hood lowered, so it remains applicable while unlit. The correctly qualified reveal-invisible sensor explicitly says hood-lowering removes bright light, but does not supply the missing conditions to these two light effects. Scenarios: lit + lowered hood still satisfies the bright effect, contradicting the printed reduction; unlit + lowered hood satisfies the dim effect, contrary to the printed while-lit lighting clause. Preserve the distinct lit/hood states in the light claims themselves or withhold them with the complete printed span.

Varied source spell versus item categories; targeted versus contact events; activated/button-specific versus merely possessed state; independent and duplicate projections; creature/object and melee-spell/range/turn attack scope; illumination versus distance and lit/unlit × raised/lowered hood. No proposed engine implementation or per-ability contract is used as closure authority.

Add proportionate generalized source-qualification evidence to the existing test, anchored to the actual printed phrases and mixed spell/item table, including representative bad-state predicate substitutions; preserve the earlier exact source-backed claims. Existing condition/trigger fields or the accepted verbatim-span mechanism suffice; no new contract layer or exhaustive natural-language proof system is required. Protect the differing predicates, not a fixed effect count. Review any forced reference edits against runtime readiness and preserve green use_item operations. The repair is material (emitted rules semantics); its next state requires fresh full review at the regenerated exact head.
